items.Sentence: The Dogwood lift station pumps raw wastewater into an 8-inch pressure main down Dogwood Lane, under the South Fork Eel River, and cross-country to the Facility
The treatment system consists of a 300,000-gallon oxidation ditch, secondary clarifier, chlorine disinfection using calcium hypochlorite tablets, and dechlorination using sodium bisulfite.

The Facility discharges treated wastewater to three percolation ponds at Discharge Point 002.
Solids removed from the secondary clarifier are dewatered in the Facility's sludge drying beds or an Aeromod Draimad bagger before being transported to an approved landfill for final disposal.

Improvements identified as part of this project include lift station SCADA improvements and pump upgrades, a new headworks process, aerator upgrades, clarifier rehabilitation, increased digestor volume, new chlorine contact basin and effluent pump station, sludge drying cover, and an electrical service transformer upgrade.
